# Validate inputs
    for name, arr in [('logp_with_result', logp_with_result), ('logp_call_only', logp_call_only), ('logp_no_call', logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy ndarray")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    # Compute sums of log probabilities (nonpositive)
    sum_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    sum_call = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    sum_none = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
    # Loss is negative sum (nonnegative)
    loss_with = -sum_with
    loss_call = -sum_call
    loss_none = -sum_none
    # Keep if loss with result is lower than both alternatives by at least tau
    keep_mask = (loss_with < loss_call - tau_filter) & (loss_with < loss_none - tau_filter)
    # Margin is the smaller improvement in loss over the best alternative
    margins = np.minimum(loss_call - loss_with, loss_none - loss_with)
    return keep_mask, margins
